s1.syndrome_frame: fever, hypotension, and rash in a patient with a history of chronic infection and recent immunotherapy
salient_findings: erythematous patches and thin plaques with telangiectases and hyperpigmentation
intravascular atypical cells on skin biopsy
key_facts: patient is a woman in her 50s
history of chronic pulmonary coccidiomycosis
being treated with fluconazole
recently stopped pembrolizumab treatment due to a morbilliform reaction
new skin eruption appeared 1-2 weeks before admission
skin eruption is widespread and asymptomatic
laboratory tests show low white blood cell count, absolute neutrophil count, hemoglobin level, and platelet count
blood culture results show no growth at 1 week
serum β-D-glucan, galactomannan, Coccidioides antibody, and immunodiffusion results are negative
respiratory viral panel and SARS-CoV-2 test results are negative
skin biopsy shows intravascular atypical cells
brain MRI, lumbar puncture, and bone marrow biopsy were performed
